nodes.name: Run the nightly
nodes.notes: Starts build/nightly.sh on the host (the same script wotr-nightly.timer runs at 03:30; disable that timer if this workflow is active, so the nightly does not run twice) and returns a job_id at once. Credential: Header Auth named X-Job-Token, value from build/.jobs_token.

nodes.name: Send it to Isaac
nodes.notes: Paste a Discord channel webhook URL (Channel -> Edit -> Integrations -> Webhooks), then enable this node. Swap it for the Gmail or Telegram node if you would rather have it there.
